rows.what_the_ink_shows: Both odd-dimensional exponents are overstruck. In the upper V'_n case, a clear leading horizontal minus is followed by thickened/merged strokes around n and a broad dark sign before the visible 1; the sign's original vertical component and the order of overwriting cannot be securely separated (crops/56_scan020_L193_Vprime_odd.png and crops/56_scan020_L193_Vprime_odd_plain.png). The lower V_n odd case has a strong cross-shaped sign before 1, while the leading minus/n region has merged strokes and an elongated hooked stroke; the surviving ink does not securely distinguish the earlier and later readings (crops/56_scan020_L193_V_odd_context.png and crops/56_scan020_L193_V_odd_plain.png). The separate relation V'_n=V_n tensor mu_m(1) is visible in crops/56_scan020_L193_Vprime_context.png. The slanted margin contains Je m'y perds, further doubtful wording, and a large doubled bidirectional arrow (crops/56_scan020_L193_confusion_note_rotated.png). The original TeX already places doubt marks on both odd exponents and on that marginal prose.
rows.note: Retain the existing in-place doubts $\mu_m(\unsure{-\frac{n+1}{2}})$ for V'_n and $\mu_m(\unsure{\tfrac{-n+1}{2}})$ for V_n. The unresolved upper alternatives are $-(n+1)/2$ and $-(n-1)/2$; the unresolved lower alternatives are $(-n+1)/2$ and $-(n+1)/2$. The overwritten layers cannot be ordered confidently enough to encode one particular old sign as deleted and another as inserted. Existing doubt marks are adequate, so no additional textual edit is proposed. The supplied mathematical correction gives $V_n=H^n(U^n)=\mu_m(-(n+1)/2)$ and $V'_n=H_c^n(U^n)=\mu_m(-(n-1)/2)$. That clean mathematical assignment is recorded as supplied rather than forced onto uncertain layered ink. The source row supports its proposed values by localization and weights; those arguments were not independently checked. This row and L904 refer to the same two overwritten loci and share the same visual review.
